name: High-Dimensional Triangulation Tables
definition: A method to generate triangulation tables for isosurface extraction in n-dimensional hypercubes, addressing the excessive simplex count produced by recursive contour-meshing which requires subdividing 4-cells into 4-simplices.
summary: High-Dimensional Triangulation Tables extract isosurfaces in n-dimensions by constructing a convex hull of edge midpoints and vertices, avoiding the excessive simplex count of recursive contour-meshing.
